captureRequirements.anonymousBoundary: Test API rejection is an observation; H03 has an explicit guard. Source fetch also guards test context, so no row attempts real network transport.
captureRequirements.sourceShape: Synthetic standard-object rows only. Dedicated field captures cover custom external-ID and unique-only metadata and native upsert.
captureRequirements.namespaceAxis: First capture no namespace. Repeat H05-H07,D01-D06,E03-E06 in a namespaced org with synthetic classes owned by that namespace; never simulate namespace by editing strings.
captureRequirements.classification: No fixture is wired into a Go test. Fill observations from native rows before adding assertions.
